research_goal: every 10 minutes reconstruct the current hydraulic state from sparse causal sensing, use a control-oriented differentiable action-conditioned hydraulic surrogate to optimize all 109 writable target settings continuously over H120 within an H360 prediction horizon, minimize system-wide cumulative TFV, treat Priority8 PFV as a one-sided soft secondary objective, and execute only the first 10-minute target in authoritative SWMM

step2_training.stage_A: source-balanced teacher-forced hydraulic transition and actuator-flow learning from D2 + targeted D3 + D4-FIT
step2_training.stage_B0: H60/H120 autoregressive truncated-rollout curriculum to reduce compounding hydraulic/managed-flow drift before the H360 objective stage

step2_training.hard_tfv: physical clamp-based surrogate reporting/evaluation, absolute magnitude supervision and continuous-vs-RBC acceptance check
step2_training.smooth_tfv: differentiable Softplus proxy used only for counterfactual effects/gradients and L-BFGS-B, not as an authoritative absolute volume
